history.content: i dont even know why im opening this. just had the worst evening
That sounds like a rough evening. We can stay with it lightly if you want — what made it feel worst?
its not really sad. im just pissed. my roommate ate the thing i was saving. again. like the SPECIFIC thing i told her i was keeping for after my shift
Ugh, that sounds really frustrating and violated. Was it more the “again” part, the specific thing, or the way they ignored what you said?

the again. 100% the again. its a leftover tub of pad thai but its not about the food its that ive asked her like four times and she just does whatever she wants and then says oh sorry i didnt see your name on it. ITS THE FRIDGE WE SHARE who else would it be
Yeah — the “again” is the sharp part here, like you’re being brushed off on purpose. Does it feel more hot and ready-to-push-back, or more tight and resentful?

tight i think. i didnt even say anything to her. i just put my bag down and came in here instead. i hate that i do that. like i swallow it every time and then im the one stewing while shes in there watching tv like nothing happened
That sounds tight and swallowed — like the anger stays in you while she carries on as if nothing happened. Does it make you want to confront her, or mostly just shut down and hold it in?

both at once honestly. part of me wants to bang on her door and be like ARE YOU KIDDING ME. but then i hear myself and im like its a takeout container becca. youre 27. so i just dont. and then i resent her more for making me feel insane over something small

Yeah, that sounds like two things colliding: the urge to push back, and the part of you that judges the whole thing as “too small.” It seems to turn into resentment and self-doubt at the same time — is that right, or is there a different name for it?

resentful yeah. but its bigger than her too if im honest. its like i do this everywhere. work, my mum, becca. i make myself small and tell myself its not a big deal and then im furious that nobody treats my stuff like it matters. but i never SAY it matters. so how would they even know

That feels bigger than the one container — like resentment that keeps finding the same shape in different places. It sounds like something about your stuff, your space, or your say not mattering is in this too; do you want to stay with that, or leave it here for now?
honestly i dont have it in me to crack open the whole my say doesnt matter thing tonight, im wiped. but yeah. thats the thread. i kind of hate that you found it that fast lol
Got it — we can leave it there, and that thread is enough for tonight. And yeah, I may have caught the thread fast, but you were the one who showed me where it was.
yeah. ok. that actually helped more than yelling at becca wouldve. still might label the next tub like a psycho though. night
Night. That feels like enough for now.
